comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
Salmon Meuniere - Buy from tavern clerk in London
Gravlax - R8 cooking recipe. Make with the Barkeep in the tavern in Stockholm
Salmon Soup - R6 cooking recipe. Also make with the Barkeep in the tavern in Stockholm
Canape - R5 cooking recipe. Make from Makeable Meats recipe book
Salmon Chowder - R10 cooking recipe. Make with the Barkeep in the tavern in San Francisco. Requires 19th century chrono time title, or item that gives the EX effect of 19th century for it to show up
Smoked Salmon - R13 cooking recipe. Also make with the Barkeep in the tavern in San Francisco. And it too, requires 19th century chrono time title, or item that gives the EX effect of 19th century for it to show up
Bagel Sandwich - R16 cooking recipe. Can either make with the Barkeep in the tavern in San Francisco with the correct time period title or EX effect item like the above two, OR get from Mysterious Bonanza Box (No.6)

Reward for completing the MA is Haseki Circlet
